activity_summary: You waited in the passage and came for the reckoning only. The share was thirty-six shillings. You did not go into the yard. Thursday's house had filled three galleries, and Pope's Gaunt drew no laugh on this England. Heminges would not say the boxes were better without you. Your line had reached Aldermanbury. Heminges and Bryan will wait on my lord's people at Somerset House within the week, so the Christmas money is not stranded with a dead man's clerks. They did not name a man in the passage. You did not spend the thirty-six on the way. The sun was down before five. There is no inn-yard this winter, and the Theatre will be played cold.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Came for the reckoning only, took the thirty-six, and refused a settlement in the passage.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Gave Thursday without the comfort about the boxes, and named the waiting within the week.

entities.name: Thomas Pope
entities.context: Said the three galleries and the want of a laugh, and did not ask to be first on a paper.

entities.name: George Bryan
entities.context: Named the thirty-six shillings, and refused to name a man while the yard was emptying.
